[WEBINAR]
Streamline Your Online Payment Process to Drive International Student Recruitment Financial integrity is fundamental to the education institution and agency relationship as well as for the families and students paying for international studies. From ensuring transparent, secure online payment transactions to optimizing your partnership strategy, this webinar <[[https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_8q0ROnm-S2C-MQYqFGxd9g]]> will give you the tools and tips you need to deliver with confidence in the 2020/2021 academic year and beyond!
Join Flywire & AIRC <[[https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_8q0ROnm-S2C-MQYqFGxd9g]]> on July 30th for an informative webinar where we’ll share real-world examples, flexible solutions and best practices to aid your international student recruitment strategies.
Presenters:
Mike Finnell, Executive Director, AIRC Jennifer Wright, Director of Certification, AIRC Fai Tai, Associate Director, Finance and Marketing, Wichita State University Sharon Butler, Executive Vice President, Global Education, Flywire Mina Fakhouri, Global Director, Agents, Flywire
Date & Time: Thursday, July 30th at 9:00 AM EST / 6:30 PM IST / 9:00 PM CST / 11:00 PM AEST
